verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only event-triggered automation: the notetaker auto-joins calendar meetings, briefings arrive before meetings, and outputs push to CRMs and task tools after each meeting. Zapier and the public API are third-party or developer building blocks. Nothing documents a user-defined recurring schedule (e.g., a cron-style or weekly job) for running workflows, so auto-join is an adjacent feature, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
